title: Market women’s peace and electoral-inclusion march reported in multiple communes, 31 October 2020
location: Cotonou: Bénin Web TV reports a route beginning near SOGEMA and ending at the prefecture; La Nouvelle Tribune gives a starting point at the Dantokpa market triangle and several communes including Bantè, Parakou, Tchaourou and Kandi. Whether location names refer to the same route or separate marches is unresolved.
organizer: Organizer naming differs across sources: Bénin Web TV names the Mouvement des Femmes Béninoises pour la Paix, while Front Souverain’s call names the Mouvement des Femmes Leader du Bénin pour la Paix; equivalence is unresolved. La Nouvelle Tribune reports opposition-personality support.
threshold_50_evidence: Neither opened report gives attendance estimates or per-site counts; the ≥50 simultaneous-participant threshold is not established.

start_date.summary: Both sources date the women’s march to 31 October 2020.

location.summary: Sources give differing Cotonou starting points (near SOGEMA vs Dantokpa market triangle) and a list of several communes; exact relation between locations/marches is unresolved.

demands.summary: Reports concern political peace, fundamental freedoms, rule of law and inclusive presidential election process in Benin.

participants.summary: No qualifying numeric count or simultaneous site-level threshold evidence found.

occurrence.summary: Two opened local outlets report an executed march; source independence and underlying organizer materials remain unresolved.

organizer.summary: The women’s peace movement is named; opposition-personality support is reported.

notes: One candidate records reported activity on 31 October, not a verified single national gathering. Organizer-name variants and municipal-order exception/scope unresolved; no automatic merge across towns or months.
open_questions: Find contemporaneous independent per-site attendance estimates and exact routes in named communes.
Clarify which political demands were formally presented to state institutions and by whom.
Check for other October public gatherings, early-month actions and September onset.
Check November continuity without treating a retrospective organizer-balance story as a November event.
Resolve the 28 October Cotonou prohibition and any exception authorizing the 31 October march using a permitted contemporaneous municipal document or independent report.
